purpose: Packaging status ledger; not an additional proof claim.

status_definitions.human_argument: A mathematical argument and finite arithmetic/formalization route are provided in the report. This status is not a machine proof.
status_definitions.compiled_semantic_lean_subset: The delivered Lean kernel compiles and proves the listed finite statements in ordinary Lean; it does not itself construct Prf PRAAx objects.
status_definitions.compiled_specification_types: The types and definitions compile; arbitrary instances and continuous theorem proofs have not been postulated.
status_definitions.upstream_object_sources_inspected: Pinned source files with embedded proof types were inspected, but their upstream build and full transitive dependency graph were not rerun.
status_definitions.continuous_embedding_pending: The complete continuous construction has a human proof and explicit target/interface plan; its final deeply embedded Prf PRAAx derivation remains to implement.

lean_validation.count_method: Declaration-level enumeration of theorem and example lines in the four source modules; comments are excluded.
lean_validation.axiom_audit_scope: Eight representative proved endpoints listed in lean/Validation.lean; reports contain propext and for some endpoints Quot.sound, but not Classical.choice or sorryAx. Not a claim that all Lean kernel axioms are absent.

python_validation.scope: finite regression and certificate checks; not universal proofs

critical_scope_notes: KolmogorovIid supplies past_hyp and future_mean for one crossing step, not the full maximal theorem.
NormalMoments identifies arithmetic coefficient formulas, not Gaussian integrals.
CompleteSquare proves polynomial identities and excludes normalization integrals.
ProductReplacement supplies finite product telescoping, not characteristic functions, smoothing or a full CLT.
The newer continuous framework sections are human research providers, not a fully compiled object-proof library.

results.result: Finite sums, event algebra, union bounds, Markov, scaled Chebyshev, rectangular independence and finite L1 stability
results.human_status: Human argument; a selected finite kernel is compiled in this package.
results.boundary: Finite arithmetic providers also exist upstream; inspect the provider map. These standalone proofs are not Prf PRAAx objects.

results.result: Fixed PR syntax, finite Eval relation and representation specifications
results.human_status: Definitions and target interfaces are explicit.
results.boundary: RegularRealSpec and RegularEventSpec compile, but their semantic proof fields are not embedded iPRA proofs. No universal PR evaluator is introduced.

results.result: Coherent cylinders; represented event, L0, L1 and L2 names and extensional equality
results.human_status: Human construction with finite rational contracts and explicit regularization.
results.boundary: Quotients and all-precision relations are interpreted through first-order schemas; complete object-language definitions and proofs remain to implement.

results.result: Represented expectation, bounded observables and Boolean event operations
results.human_status: Human proof from finite contraction/linearity estimates.
results.boundary: Finite expectation and event stability are checked; the full continuous bridge is not compiled.

results.result: Threshold lifting with PR boundary-band certificates
results.human_status: Human proof with a displayed reindexing and rational error budget.
results.boundary: No unconditional decision procedure for real comparisons or hard-event probabilities is claimed.

results.result: Effective countable unions and additivity under finite-union residual moduli
results.human_status: Human construction through regularized finite unions.
results.boundary: Requires jointly PR event names and a supplied or constructed residual rate; not an arbitrary sigma-algebra completion.

results.result: Clipping, quantitative Vitali completion and modulated dominated convergence
results.human_status: Human finite inequality and derived convergence rate.
results.boundary: Convergence and integrability data are explicit; qualitative convergence alone does not produce a PR modulus.

results.result: Dyadic conditional averages, tower identity and terminal-variable martingale convergence
results.human_status: Human proof from finite averaging and contraction.
results.boundary: The canonical martingale of a supplied L1 terminal variable is treated, not arbitrary bounded-martingale convergence.

results.result: Independent bit rows, uniform random variable and Cantor singular continuous law
results.human_status: Explicit human constructions and finite arithmetic estimates.
results.boundary: Selected finite examples and product identities are checked; no generic probability-space extension theorem is asserted.

results.result: Uniform, exponential, normal and Cauchy laws; normalization, tails and available moments
results.human_status: Human analytic argument with rational evaluation, quadrature and tail budgets.
results.boundary: Exact Gaussian enclosures are executable checks; Gaussian normalization/moment integrals are not claimed as compiled embedded proofs.

results.result: Coherent histogram realization of effective densities and certified moment upgrades
results.human_status: Human finite monotone-coupling and dyadic-sampling construction.
results.boundary: Connects scalar density laws to random variables on the common cylinder space. Full deep embedding remains a target.

results.result: Upper-envelope bounds, positive-evidence Bayes updates, conditional densities and bounded stopping
results.human_status: Human finite/represented arguments with explicit hypotheses.
results.boundary: No unconditional disintegration or conditioning by division by a null event.

results.result: Finite-horizon continuous-state transitions and an autoregressive Gaussian invariant law
results.human_status: Human construction with error recurrence and quantitative Gaussian-law comparison.
results.boundary: No general continuous-time process or stochastic-integral theory; convergence of marginal laws is distinct from pathwise convergence.

results.result: Represented Fubini, convolution, Gaussian convolution and Gaussian conditional kernel
results.human_status: Human proof with finite products, completion of squares and absolute tails.
results.boundary: Upstream polynomial identities do not alone prove analytic normalization or convolution.

results.result: Quantitative weak law, finite-window strong law and small exceptional-event certificates
results.human_status: Human proof with explicit finite maximal inequality and countable residual rates.
results.boundary: Existing upstream finite weak-law and crossing providers were inspected, not rebuilt; KolmogorovIid alone is not the full maximal theorem.

results.result: Smooth-test CLT and CDF smoothing with explicit sufficient sample size
results.human_status: Human Lindeberg replacement proof and explicit quintic smoothing budget.
results.boundary: Requires matching moments, third-moment/tail data and CDF boundary certificates for a genuine CDF theorem. No optimal Berry--Esseen rate or compiled analytic CLT is claimed.

not_claimed: A completed deeply embedded continuous probability library in iPRA.
All Borel descriptions have computable probability or regular event names.
Convergence or integrability rates can be extracted from arbitrary qualitative hypotheses.
Generic conditional distributions are computable without separation and uniformity data.
A universal primitive-recursive evaluator for arbitrary PR programs.
Numerical regression checks constitute proofs of the universal analytic results.
